question: How do I create an EduLearn account?
answer: Click Sign Up on the EduLearn home page, enter your name, email address, and password, then verify your email to activate the account.

question: How can I enroll in a course?
answer: Open the course page, click Enroll Now, complete the payment if the course is paid, and the course will appear in your dashboard.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the login page, select Forgot Password, enter the email linked to your account, and use the reset link sent to your inbox.

question: Will I get a certificate after completing a course?
answer: Yes. After completing all required lessons and assessments, you can download your course completion certificate from the course dashboard.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: EduLearn accepts credit cards, debit cards, UPI, and selected digital wallets. Available methods are shown during checkout.

question: Can I download course videos to watch offline?
answer: Offline downloads are available in the EduLearn mobile app for courses where the instructor has enabled downloads.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Open the Help Center and choose Contact Support. You can submit a support request with your account email and a short description of the issue.

question: What is the refund policy?
answer: You can request a refund within 7 days of purchase if you have completed less than 20% of the course. Refund eligibility is reviewed by the support team.

question: Where can I see my enrolled courses?
answer: After signing in, open My Learning from the dashboard. It lists every course you have enrolled in and your current progress.

question: Can I change my email address?
answer: Yes. Go to Profile Settings, choose Account Information, enter your new email address, and confirm it through the verification email.
